items.title: What Does a SpaceX Moon Crash Mean for the Booming Space Economy?
items.summary: Humans, mainly thanks to  SpaceX  are putting more things into orbit—and that can lead to some interesting events.  On Aug. 5, a day after SpaceX reported second-quarter earnings, a SpaceX Falcon 9 upper stage hit the moon, creating an impact crater (and media buzz).  On Tuesday, NASA released images of a 60-foot-wide, 10-foot-deep crater.
